title: 知能情報プログラミングⅡ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Intelligent Information Programming II
teachers:
MOTOKI Mitsuo
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Subsequent to the precedent course, i.e., Programming I, students learn basic programming in Python which is often used in data science and AI, to acquire writing various programs.  Specifically, students learn the following: using objects, iterators, and file operations.
advice:
In this class, students learn basic Python programming subsequent to the precedent class, i.e., Programming I.

Contents of Python:
(1) Data containers such as dictionary and set
(2) Concept of object, and class
(3) Programming with iterators that is the mechanism of accessing stored data
(4) Writing complicated programs using file I/O or exceptions
requiredKnowledge:
The precedent course: Programming I
- Students have to bring own laptop computer, AC adopter, and network cable for software installation, download of course materials, and upload of answer of quizzes
- PC operation skills (such as touch typing, file operation, etc.) are necessary to write program smoothly

activityGoals.body: Be able to write Python programs using dictionary, and/or set
Be able to write Python programs using objects
Be able to write Python programs operating data in data structure using iterator appropriately
Be able to write Python programs operating file I/O

achievementLevels.ideal:
In addition to standard achievement level,
(1+) Be able to write Python programs using dictionary and/or set appropriately
(2+) Be able to write Python programs using objects appropriately
(3+) Be able to write Python programs using list comprehension or itertools module appropriately
(4+) Be able to write Python programs useing text file I/O appropriately
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Be able to operate dictionary and set in Python
(2) Be able to operate objects in Python
(3) Be able to use the iterator and list comprehension in Python
(4) Be able to operate text file in Python
